first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: Person A
entities.identification: The person on the central Light-Colored Bare Soil Patch, wearing a light-colored hat, with long dark hair, a light-colored top, and dark long pants.

entities.name: Animal A
entities.identification: The light-brown, medium-sized dog-shaped animal immediately beside Person A's legs, with a darker head and ear area and some legs occluding one another.

entities.name: Golden Dry Grassland
entities.identification: The broad expanse of golden to yellow-brown short grassland covering the foreground and middle ground.

entities.name: Mixed Woodland Belt
entities.identification: The woodland extending along the far edge of the grassland, ranging from dark green and yellow-green to brownish green, with crowns of varying shapes and heights.

entities.name: Sky
entities.identification: The bright sky above and between the tree crowns, appearing mostly nearly white in this clip.

entities.name: Light-Colored Bare Soil Patch
entities.identification: The light gray-yellow, low, flat ground patch with irregular edges beneath Person A's and Animal A's feet.

entities.name: Cluster of Gray-Brown Rocks
entities.identification: The low Cluster of Gray-Brown Rocks with irregular outlines among clumps of grass near the woodland edge on the image-left side in the later part of the clip.

entities.name: Tall Dry Grass at the Woodland Edge
entities.identification: The grass clumps near the woodland edge on the image-left side, taller than the surrounding short grass and having yellow-brown clustered outlines.

entities.name: Woodland-Edge Ground Area
entities.identification: The low, flat gray-yellow to gray-brown ground in the middle-to-far distance on the image-left side, in front of the woodland, interspersed with grass textures and tree shadows.

entities.name: Open-Sided Shed with a Gray Roof
entities.identification: The shed at the distant woodland edge on the image-right side, with a gray sloping roof, thin support posts, and a dark area beneath the roof.
